We need build a static site. Use Three.js. Question: internet availability at build time? We can npm install three and use Vite. But default-start only supports vite projects, and builds. That's ideal. Need package.json with vite + three. But npm install may work via network (likely). Alternatively vendor Three.js from CDN into file. But offline evaluation may not have network; bundling three with npm is safest but node_modules output built. Vite build produces dist, start script rebuilds and serves. It installs dependencies if hash mismatch. Need package-lock? Could just package.json and npm install locally to build. Network likely enabled (websearch available). Let's test npm view or curl.

We need design a compelling game: low-poly Forza Horizon 5 clone. Features:
- 10 starter cars with distinct stats/visuals
- big open world (Mexico-inspired: desert, jungle, volcano, coast, festival site)
- good car physics: arcade-sim; engine torque curve, gears, weight transfer? Could implement raycast vehicle ourselves or use cannon-es? Better custom arcade physics with suspension, grip, drift, downforce, handbrake; terrain height.
- atmosphere: sunset/golden hour sky, volumetric-ish fog, mountains, palm trees, cacti, birds, festival balloons, particle dust, skid marks, speed lines, bloom.
- UI: Forza-like start menu with car selection (10 cars), stats, colors; HUD with speedometer, gear, minimap, race events, points combos (drift/skill chains), rivals.
- controls desktop keyboard + gamepad + mobile touch. Mobile support per Agents.md.

Need ensure performance in SwiftShader (software rendering) for screenshots. Keep poly low, draw calls merged/instanced. World maybe 3km x 3km. Use InstancedMesh for trees etc. Terrain grid maybe 256x256 ~130k tris. Low-poly.

}

## Objective
- Build a very simple low-poly browser clone of Forza Horizon 5, with 10 starter cars, a large open world, good car physics, and strong atmosphere.
- Implemented as a Three.js + Vite static site in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Requirements
- User request (Russian): "Сделай очень простой низкополигональный клон Forza Horizon 5 .сделай начальные 10 машин и большой открытый мир с хорошей физикой автомобилей.добавь хорошую атмосферу"
- Game must be playable in browser; desktop and mobile touch support.
- Main capture auto-click needs a visible button whose exact text/aria-label is `Play` or `Start`; current main button text is `PLAY` with `aria-label="Play"`.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js, Vite, procedural low-poly geometry/assets; no external 3D models.
- Single-page game with title screen, garage, free roam, 5 race events, minimap/full map, pause, results, synth audio.
- Car physics: custom arcade-sim with gears/RPM/torque, lateral grip, handbrake drift, offroad grip loss, jumps, boost, obstacle collisions.
- World: 4200×4200 units, procedural terrain, volcano, coast/town, jungle, desert, airfield, festival, roads, instanced vegetation, balloons, clouds, wildlife, smoke.
- Atmosphere: 4 time presets (golden/day/dusk/night), custom sky shader, fog, water shader, procedural audio/music/engine.
- Use bundled `@fontsource` Barlow/Barlow Condensed fonts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created package/project setup and installed dependencies.
- Implemented 10 cars and procedural car builder in `src/cars.js`.
- Implemented open world, terrain, roads, festival, town, lighthouse, airfield, scenery, map, sky/water/lighting in `src/world.js`.
- Implemented vehicle physics/visuals in `src/vehicle.js`.
- Implemented dust/smoke/skids/particles in `src/effects.js`.
- Implemented procedural engine/wind/music/UI audio in `src/audio.js`.
- Implemented full UI markup and CSS in `index.html`, `src/style.css`.
- Implemented game bootstrap, menus, garage, map, events, races, HUD, camera, touch/gamepad/keyboard in `src/main.js`.
- Fixed `mergeGeometries` crash by converting indexed geometries to non-indexed in `colored()`.
- Vite production build succeeds.
- Dev server running at `http://localhost:3003`; production server at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Title screen screenshot generated at `screenshots/title-01.png`; no console errors after merge fix.
- Driving screenshot requested at `screenshots/drive-01.png`; capture command completed but image not yet inspected.

### Active
- Visually validate driving screenshot and improve issues visible in title screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/drive-01.png` for HUD/gameplay rendering and console/runtime issues.
2. Fix car wheel visibility: wheels are mostly hidden inside body; widen effective track by ~0.12–0.18 m in `buildCar()` and update fender flare positions.
3. Improve title composition/atmosphere: camera angle is currently `2.32` and faces away from stage/sun; try angle around `0.75–0.85` so festival stage, ferris wheel, and sun are in frame.
4. Improve car silhouette/detail if driving view looks slab-like; ensure wheels, lights, cabin, and spoiler read clearly.
5. Test garage, map, race countdown/checkpoints/results, pause, time presets, mobile 390×844, and keyboard driving.
6. Run final desktop/mobile screenshots via `playwright-cli`, verify no console errors; then rebuild production (`npx vite build --base ./`) and ensure `./start.sh` serves correctly.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: boot, state machine, UI bindings, camera, race/HUD logic, debug hooks.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: terrain/heightAt, roads, festival, props, sky/water, map generation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/cars.js`: 10-car roster, stats, procedural car factory.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/vehicle.js`: custom vehicle physics and car visual updates.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: full UI styling and responsive/touch layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: screens/markup for loading, title, HUD, garage, map, pause, results.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/effects.js`: particles, skid marks, shake, airtime messages.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: WebAudio engine/music/UI sounds.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/title-01.png`: current title screenshot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/drive-01.png`: latest gameplay screenshot awaiting inspection.
- `/tmp/hl-start.log`: production server log.
- `/tmp/hl-dev.log`: Vite dev server log.

## Important Context
- Repo is a git worktree with only scaffolding originally; all game files are new and currently uncommitted.
- Production server is in tmux session `hl`; dev server is in tmux session `dev`.
- Renderer detected as software: `ANGLE (Mesa, Vulkan 1.4.318 (llvmpipe ...))`; `window.__game.software === true`, so quality is lowered (pixelRatio 1, 1024 shadow map).
- Debug hooks available at `window.__game`: `start()`, `startRace(i)`, `openGarage()`, `openMap()`, `setTime(name)`, `teleport(x,z,yaw)`, `snapCamera()`, `selectCar(index)`.
- Title screenshot observations: sky is brown/washed out, sun/stage not in view; car is a large teal slab with hidden wheels; festival looks sparse. Improve atmosphere/composition and car readability.
- Build command used: `npx vite build --base ./`.
- Vite build output ~632 kB JS chunk warning only; no build failure.
- `window.__scene = { rendered: true, gpu, software, world: true }` exists for capture checks.
- Playwright CLI browser was installed manually via `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.
- Current `title` screen uses `#btnPlay` text exactly `PLAY`, satisfying capture auto-start.

## Objective
- Build a very simple low-poly browser clone of Forza Horizon 5 with 10 starter cars, a large open world, good car physics, and strong atmosphere.
- Implemented as a Three.js + Vite static site in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Requirements
- Original request (Russian): "Сделай очень простой низкополигональный клон Forza Horizon 5 .сделай начальные 10 машин и большой открытый мир с хорошей физикой автомобилей.добавь хорошую атмосферу"
- Game must be playable in browser with desktop and mobile touch support.
- Main capture auto-click needs a visible button with exact text/aria-label `Play` or `Start`; current button text is `PLAY` with `aria-label="Play"`.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js, Vite, and procedural low-poly geometry/assets; no external 3D models.
- Single-page game with title, garage, free roam, 5 race events, minimap/full map, pause, results, and synth audio.
- Implement custom arcade-sim physics with gears/RPM/torque, lateral grip, handbrake drift, offroad grip loss, jumps, boost, and collisions.
- World is 4200×4200 units with procedural terrain, volcano, coast/town, jungle, desert, airfield, festival, roads, vegetation, balloons, clouds, wildlife, and smoke.
- Four atmosphere presets: golden/day/dusk/night, with custom sky/water shaders, fog, procedural audio, and night headlights.
- Use bundled `@fontsource` Barlow/Barlow Condensed fonts.
- Move free-roam spawn and Festival Circuit start away from the HORIZON arch pillars to prevent the car spawning inside a collision/pillar.
- Improve car readability by widening visual track, raising ride height, exposing wheels, adding roof/spoiler/diffuser details, and adding menu/gameplay fill lighting.

## Work State

### Completed
- Project setup, dependencies, dev/production servers, and prior successful Vite build.
- 10-car roster and procedural car builder in `src/cars.js`.
- Open world, terrain, roads, festival, town, lighthouse, airfield, scenery, map, sky, water, and lighting in `src/world.js`.
- Vehicle physics/visuals in `src/vehicle.js`; effects, audio, full UI, menus, races, HUD, camera, touch/gamepad/keyboard in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
- Car visuals improved: visual track `def.track + 0.22`, ride height `wheelR * 1.12`, exposed wheels/tubs/fender flares, larger roof, roof spine, side blades, low ducktail spoiler, rear diffuser, and larger menu lights.
- Physics fixed to preserve world-space momentum when yaw changes; handbrake drift now produces real lateral slip and drift points.
- Spawn moved to `(14, 108)`, yaw `0.04`; free-roam view now shows the festival gate, tents, and road instead of spawning inside an arch pillar.
- Festival Circuit route start changed to `[14, 108]`; race start no longer places the car against the arch.
- HORIZON arch banner now has a correctly oriented front and rear plane.
- Terrain vertex colors converted to sRGB, reducing the washed-out look.
- Golden-hour preset updated: sun azimuth `242`, elevation `11`, warmer fog, deeper upper sky, lower exposure; sun and festival stage are visible on the title screen.
- Title/garage camera angles improved; menu car is now front-quarter framed with stage, ferris wheel, sun, and gate.
- Night preset now uses a functional vehicle headlight spotlight.
- Mobile portrait improvements: larger title camera distance, responsive car framing, smaller minimap/wallet, compact touch controls, and dedicated CSS for 390×844.
- Mobile HUD announcements fixed so subtitle and title no longer overlap.
- Desktop title/driving, mobile title/driving, garage, map, race countdown, pause, results, all 10 car models, and all four time presets were visually tested with no console/page errors.
- Physics verified via direct stepping: 0–100 km/h in roughly 4 s, automatic upshifts, handbrake drift works, and top speed continues to build.

### Active
- Final visual/gameplay QA and production rebuild after the latest changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Fix race countdown UI showing `0 м` before the race starts by initializing `cpDistance` from the first checkpoint in `startRace`/`buildCheckpoints`.
2. Test mobile garage, mobile map, and landscape phone layout (844×390), plus touch gas/steer/boost/handbrake input.

## Что реализовано
- **10 стартовых машин**: Brisa GT, Sierra RS, Volcán R, Marea Spyder, Camino Rey, Lobo GT3, Cielo 68, Eléctrico X, Duna Buggy, Toro Bronco.
- **Открытый мир 4200×4200**: фестиваль, вулкан, побережье, город, джунгли, пустыня, аэродром, дороги, трафик-декор, воздушные шары, дым, облака и дикая природа.
- **Аркадная физика**: передачи, обороты, крутящий момент, сцепление, дрифт на ручнике, потеря сцепления на бездорожье, прыжки, нитро и столкновения.
- **5 гонок**, карта мира, гараж, пауза, результаты, HUD, мини-карта и процедурный звук.
- **4 времени суток**: golden hour, день, сумерки и ночь с фарами.
- **Управление**: WASD / стрелки, Space — ручник, Shift — нитро, C — камера, G — гараж, M — карта, Esc — пауза. На телефоне — экранные кнопки газа, тормоза, руля, ручника и нитро.
